shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && ls -R .agents | head -50 && cat AGENTS.md && ls && git ls-files | head -50

cat package.json src/App.tsx src/main.tsx; ls __agent_eval__; sed -n 1,60p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; rg -n -i "toast|toaster|notif" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -30
.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Toaster ToasterProvider ToasterComponent useToaster Toast Button 2>&1 | head -60; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -40
bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Toaster ToasterProvider ToasterComponent useToaster Toast 2>&1 | head -60

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls build/esm/components/Toaster/ build/esm/components/Toaster/*/ 2>/dev/null | head -40; cat build/esm/components/Toaster/types.d.ts build/esm/components/Toaster/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster && cat Provider/ToasterProvider.d.ts ToasterComponent/ToasterComponent.d.ts Toaster.d.ts hooks/useToaster.d.ts constants.d.ts; ls ToasterComponent; cat README.md 2>/dev/null | head -5; ls ../../../../ ; rg -n -i "toaster" ../../../../README.md | head
cd /tmp && curl -sS -m 20 https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt -o uikit7.txt; wc -c uikit7.txt; rg -n -i "toaster" uikit7.txt | head -20

rg -n -C 3 "Button view|view=" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -60; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/ToasterComponent/ToasterComponent.js; rg -n "position|bottom|right|top" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Toaster.css 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/ToastList

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && rg -n -B2 -A8 "^\.g-toaster\s*\{|\.g-toaster \{" build/esm/components/Toaster/ToastList/ToastList.css build/esm/components/Toaster/Toast/Toast.css | head -30; rg -n "autoHiding|DEFAULT" build/esm/components/Toaster/Toast/Toast.js build/esm/components/Toaster/constants.js | head
